correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic calculations verify the Darboux polynomial identity, global diffeomorphism for b nonzero, transformed flow, dissipative energy, equilibria and action. No finite experiment is used as an infinite-domain proof.

value.rationale: The cancellation plane is fixed structurally by the unique vanishings of a quadratic cofactor rather than by arbitrary numeric tuning; the result identifies a rigorously nonrecurrent manifold across all b in a classical chaotic-flow family, classifies complete bounded trajectories and all compact stationary states, and supplies one exact physically meaningful heteroclinic dissipation law.
